title: EmDash publish and unpublish show in Site changes: an admin's as Unknown, Tracy's own as Chat only, a scheduled publish as Automatic
steps: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): ORIGIN (= O), PG, WEB, HOST, DSH, A and seat A's cookie COOKIE_A, pq (SELECT/WITH only). Case variables: KEY and LABEL = site key and container prefix of an EmDash 1.0.x site where seat A is owner, with a `posts` collection holding at least two live `en` entries P (admin) and Q (Tracy) — pick them with em "select id, title from ec_posts where locale='en' and status='published' and deleted_at is null and draft_revision_id is null and scheduled_at is null limit 2". HARNESS = tasks/evidence/emdash-attribution/act-as-person.mjs of this checkout. On the shared stand (ORIGIN http://tracy.test:8080): PG=tracy-postgres-1, WEB=tracy-tracy-web-1, HOST=tracy-tracy-host-1, DSH=tracy-dsh; mint COOKIE_A inside $WEB with /opt/tracy-web/src/lib/session.js mintSession(A, SESSION_SECRET.split(",")[0]) (never print the secret); the measured site is KEY=c1em1004.tracy.test, LABEL=c1em1004, A=emattr-a@example.test.

Check the builds: docker exec $WEB grep -c 'entry-state:scheduled-publish' /opt/tracy-web/src/sites/activity-source.js must print >= 1, docker exec $HOST grep -c 'emdashPublishState' /opt/tracy-host/src/cms-log.js >= 1, docker exec $HOST grep -c 'TRACY_CMS_LOG_SINCE' /opt/tracy-fleet/webroot/cms-log.sh >= 1, and pq "select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_name='site_cms_log_cursor' and column_name='state'" = 1; otherwise stop with BLOCKED note stand-older-than-this-feature.

Admin session (no mail on the stand): ADMIN = the EmDash user of A (em "select id from users where lower(email)='$A'"; none → BLOCKED no-admin-user). On the host make a 32-byte token TOK (base64url) and HASH = base64url(sha256(bytes of base64url-decoded TOK)); inside $LABEL-web-1 (-w /app, better-sqlite3) insert into auth_tokens (hash,user_id,email,type,role,invited_by,expires_at,created_at) values (HASH, ADMIN, A, 'magic_link', 50, null, now+1h ISO, now ISO). PORT = the 127.0.0.1 port of $LABEL-web-1's 4321/tcp. curl -c $Q/jar -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Origin: http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" --data '{"token":"'$TOK'"}' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/_emdash/api/auth/magic-link/verify must answer success:true. adm() = curl -b $Q/jar -X <METHOD> -H "Origin: http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" -H 'X-EmDash-Request: 1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' [--data <json>] http://127.0.0.1:$PORT<path> — the same doors the admin screen calls, as that admin.

Snapshot: POST $O/api/sites/$KEY/cms-log/pull (cookie A, Origin $O, body {}) twice, 6 s apart. pq "select state is not null from site_cms_log_cursor where site_key='$KEY' and source='emdash-audit-log'" must be t. Set C0=$(pq "select coalesce(max(id),0) from site_cms_change where site_key='$KEY'"), W0=$(pq "select coalesce(max(id),0) from site_write where site_key='$KEY'") and U0 = counts.unknown of GET $O/api/sites/$KEY/activity?version=2&filter=all&limit=1 (cookie A).
Admin unpublish: adm POST /_emdash/api/content/posts/$P/unpublish '{}' (success:true). Wait 6 s, pull once.

Tracy unpublish and publish of Q, as seat A's conversation: docker cp $HARNESS $DSH:/tmp/act-as-person.mjs; LIB=/desk-home/profiles/native/node_modules/@tracy/dsh-site-tools/lib/index.js; REV = the _rev of docker exec -u www-data -e SESSION=session-reg066-$RUN $DSH node /tmp/act-as-person.mjs $LIB $LABEL $A '[{"tool":"content_get","arguments":{"collection":"posts","id":"'$Q'"}}]'; then the same with '[{"tool":"content_unpublish","arguments":{"collection":"posts","id":"'$Q'","_rev":"'$REV'"}}]' (answer ok:true; REV2 = answer.result._rev), wait 6 s, pull once; then '[{"tool":"content_publish","arguments":{"collection":"posts","id":"'$Q'","_rev":"'$REV2'"}}]' (ok:true), wait 6 s, pull once. Remove /tmp/act-as-person.mjs from $DSH at the end of the case, whatever the verdict, as root (docker exec -u 0 $DSH rm -f …: docker cp leaves it root-owned in the sticky /tmp).

Scheduled publish: D = data.item.id of adm POST /_emdash/api/content/posts '{"data":{"title":"REG-066 scheduled '$RUN'"},"slug":"reg066-'$RUN'","locale":"en"}'; S = now + 70 s (ISO); adm POST /_emdash/api/content/posts/$D/schedule '{"scheduledAt":"'$S'"}' (status scheduled). Wait 6 s and pull once (the snapshot now holds D as scheduled for S). Then poll em "select status from ec_posts where id='$D'" every 5 s until 'published' (at most 180 s; EmDash sweeps every <= 60 s); wait 6 s, pull once.

Read pq "select resource_id, op, cms_actor is null or cms_actor = 'null'::jsonb, change_type, cursor_key from site_cms_change where site_key='$KEY' and id > $C0 and change_type like 'entry-state:%' order by id", pq "select action, outcome, actor, target->>'kind', target->>'id' from site_write where site_key='$KEY' and id > $W0 order by id", and GET $O/api/sites/$KEY/activity?version=2&filter=all&limit=100 (cookie A; follow nextCursor, at most 5 pages) and GET $O/api/sites/$KEY/cms-log?limit=100 (cookie A).

Put the site back: adm POST /_emdash/api/content/posts/$P/publish '{}' and adm DELETE /_emdash/api/content/posts/$D (to the trash); these make one more Unknown publish row (P) and one Unknown delete row (D), by design of what is measured here.
expect: The build checks print >= 1 and the state column exists; the magic-link verify answers success:true; after the two snapshot pulls the cursor row holds a state.

site_cms_change gained, for the measured actions, exactly these entry-state rows (in order; all with no account): P 'unpublish' change_type 'entry-state:unpublish'; Q 'unpublish' 'entry-state:unpublish'; Q 'publish' 'entry-state:publish'; D 'publish' 'entry-state:scheduled-publish'. No row for D's creation or scheduling, and no publish row for P (P was not published again before the read).
site_write gained content_unpublish then content_publish, outcome 'ok', actor A, target kind 'posts', target id Q (before this feature the two Q rows in site_cms_change did not exist at all).

Activity V2: the P unpublish row is an item with origin.source 'unknown', description.key 'resource.op', description.params.op 'unpublish', id 'emdash-audit-log:<its cursor_key>'. Neither Q row is an item of its own (no evidence.cmsRecordRef names them) and the cms-log door lists neither; the Q writes are a Chat item. The D row is an item with origin.source 'automatic', actor.name 'EmDash', description.params.op 'publish'.
counts.unknown after the scheduled publish = U0 + 1 (the P unpublish only; before this feature: U0, because nothing was recorded).
/tmp/act-as-person.mjs is gone from $DSH at the end.

selectors.cmsLog: site_cms_change(source='emdash-audit-log', op in ('publish','unpublish'), change_type like 'entry-state:%', cms_actor null)
selectors.activityApi: GET /api/sites/:key/activity?version=2 → counts{unknown}, items[].origin.source, items[].actor.name, items[].description.params.op, items[].evidence.cmsRecordRef

evidence: tasks/evidence/emdash-attribution/publish-state-measure.md (measurement), reg066-driver.mjs (the steps as one script, shared stand values), c1em1004/publish-state-diffs.txt; tests: apps/tracy-host/test/cms-log.test.mjs (emdash state), apps/tracy-web/test/cms-log.test.mjs (snapshot), apps/tracy-web/test/activity-source.test.mjs (C1 publish).
fence: The EmDash collector compares each entry's publish state between pulls (snapshot beside the cursor, first pull silent) and stores publish/unpublish rows with no account; Tracy's own content_publish/content_unpublish hide the matching row by site + collection + id + op, never by time; a publish at or after the entry's scheduled time with the schedule gone is Automatic (EmDash); everything else stays Unknown.
